result.keywords: This fictional study presents a non-robotic field method for mapping nocturnal dune migration using acoustic reflectance mats, kite-borne thermal sketches, and seasonal grain alignment sampling. The work focuses on arid coastal basins and emphasizes manual cartographic annotation rather than automated sensing, control, or biological measurement. Results are framed as a descriptive atlas of dune shape drift, salt crust interruptions, and wind-shadow boundaries across three survey transects.
result.title: Moonrift Cartography of Elastic Sand Dunes.
